title: My Sunday battery drawer reset 🔋 The 10-minute habit that made drop-off day so much easier
content:
I used to throw loose batteries into one random drawer and tell myself I would "sort them later." Later never came, and the drawer became a tiny chaos zone. This month I finally changed the system, and it made battery recycling feel so much less annoying.

What I do now:
- one small box for AA and AAA batteries
- one separate pouch for button batteries
- a roll of tape right next to the box for lithium battery terminals
- one note in my phone with nearby drop-off spots

My routine is super simple:
1. Empty the drawer completely.
2. Check which batteries are actually dead and which still belong to something.
3. Tape the terminals on anything rechargeable or lithium-based.
4. Group the rest by size so the final drop-off is faster.

This sounds tiny, but the visual difference is huge. I feel much more likely to recycle them properly when everything is already sorted and safe. If your "battery drawer" has turned into a mystery corner too, try doing a quick reset before it gets worse. It is one of those boring little tasks that feels surprisingly satisfying afterward. 🧺
